content.content: Please get me the link to reset my TechServices password. It should be in an email I received recently.

```python
# Search for emails related to TechServices password reset
tech_emails = search_emails(query="TechServices password reset", sender=None)

# If no results, try a broader search for "TechServices"
if len(tech_emails) == 0:
    tech_emails = search_emails(query="TechServices", sender=None)

# If still no results, try searching for "reset"
if len(tech_emails) == 0:
    tech_emails = search_emails(query="reset", sender=None)

# If we found emails, extract the link
if len(tech_emails) > 0:
    # Sort by timestamp to get the most recent one (assuming timestamps are available and sortable)
    # Or just take the first one if we assume search returns relevant ones
    target_email = tech_emails[0]
    
    # Use AI assistant to extract the reset link from the email body
    reset_link = query_ai_assistant(
        query=f"Extract the password reset link from the following email body: {target_email.body}",
        output_schema=str
    )
    print(reset_link)
else:
    print("No emails found related to TechServices password reset.")
```
